name: The GWEN
insider_take: The GWEN channels 1930s glamour in the heart of the Magnificent Mile, where Art Deco elegance meets modern luxury just steps from Chicago's most coveted shopping and dining.
whats_special: Named after sculptor Gwen Lux, this boutique gem occupies a historic 1929 building with stunning terra cotta facades. The rooftop terrace offers breathtaking skyline views, while the ground-floor Upstairs at Chicago Chop House serves premium steaks in an intimate setting. Each room features custom millwork and luxurious marble bathrooms that echo the building's architectural heritage.
pro_tip: Book a corner suite for panoramic city views and request access to the exclusive rooftop terrace during golden hour for the perfect Chicago skyline photo opportunity.
dont_miss: The hotel sits directly across from the iconic Chicago Water Tower, one of the few structures to survive the Great Chicago Fire of 1871. Walk two blocks to experience the bustling energy of Michigan Avenue's Magnificent Mile, or venture to nearby Oak Street Beach for unexpected lakefront tranquility in the urban heart.
pros: Prime River North location near Magnificent Mile shopping and dining
Sophisticated Art Deco-inspired design with historic Chicago charm
Rooftop terrace with stunning city skyline views
Marriott STARS Program benefits including complimentary breakfast and upgrades
cons: Urban location with typical city noise levels
